newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: EEI Corp has orders worth 4.6 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: EEI Corp has orders worth 4.6 bln pesos.

text.p: Engineering construction firm EEI Corp said on Tuesday the value of its various construction projects and sales of machinery for the first semester of the year totalled 4.63 billion pesos.
The order book's worth was up 23.8 percent from 3.74 billion in the same period last year, EEI Corp said in a statement.
EEI chairman and chief executive officer Teodoro Taguinod said the performance was in line with the company's projections for the year.
"We expect accelerated production in on-going jobs and robust level of orders and contracts which should enable us to equal if not exceed our income forecast of 310 million (pesos) in 1997," he said.
EEI Corp expects to book close to 10 billion pesos worth of orders and contracts for the whole of 1997. In 1996, orders had amounted to 7.40 billion pesos.
EEI Corp is a major sub-contractor of the EDSA MRT project, a metro rail system that is now under construction in Manila.
